hero.title: AI-DEF Solutions
hero.text2: Shortening the decision cycle — from detection to action — faster than the situation evolves.

intro.title: Our Solutions
intro.text2: The modern battlefield is not about who has more sensors or carriers. It's about who can find, confirm, track and hit the target faster - before the situation changes. The moment the pace of the conflict accelerates, manual analysis ceases to keep up. AI becomes a crucial skill multiplier.
intro.text3: The decision is made by the one who can find the target faster (FIND), assign the right resources (ASSETS), choose the optimal effector, perform the hit, evaluate the effect and predict the opponent's reaction. AI-DEF turns sensor data into accurate decisions and real effects.

decisions.title: Why AI makes decisions
decisions.text2: Even with the same hardware (UAVs, radars, satellites, optics), there is a fundamental difference in how quickly and accurately information is converted into action:

find.title: FIND
find.text2: Automatic detection and classification of objects in massive sensor data in real time.
find.text3: AI-DEF automatically searches for relevant contacts in real-time and eliminates noise:
find.text4: detection and classification of objects/persons/vehicles from EO/IR, radars and other sources
find.text5: filtering "false positives", prioritization according to threat and context
find.text6: Instant target marking, tactical image sharing (SA)
find.text7: Added value: FIND will cease to be a manual activity and will become a continuous automated process.

track.title: FIX + TRACK
track.text2: FIX (precise determination): refinement of the position and parameters of the target by combining several sources (data fusion)
track.text3: TRACK: predict movement, maintain contact even when camouflaging, manoeuvring and jamming
track.text4: Stable target tracking even when manoeuvring, camouflaging and jamming
track.text5: Prediction of trajectory and target behavior for track maintenance

assess.title: DECIDE + ASSESS
assess.text2: DECIDE (choice of effect): recommendation of the optimal response according to risks, stocks, distances, weather and rules of use
assess.text3: ASSESS (evaluation): immediate verification of the effect and update of the situational picture
assess.text4: AI-DEF selects and recommends the most suitable means according to:
assess.text5: range, time to intervention, availability, battery/fuel status and sensor
assess.text6: risks, terrain, weather, EW situation and rules of use (ROE)
assess.text7: tactical priority and value of the target
assess.text8: Added value: less improvisation, more optimization — the right means in the right place at the right time.

attack.title: ATTACK
attack.text3: AI-DEF helps to choose the optimal effector and deployment method according to the type of target and situation:
attack.text5: optimization of the timing and profile of the attack (probability of hit vs. risk)
attack.text6: coordination of multiple means (sequential / concurrent) for higher effect
attack.text7: Added value: an attack is not "just a launch", but a controlled process of maximizing the effect and minimizing the risk.

bda.title: BDA
bda.text3: Without a fast BDA, the cycle lengthens and the opponent gains time:
bda.text4: automatic evaluation of intervention from sensors (EO/IR, SAR/radar, telemetry)
bda.text5: Resolution: destroyed / damaged / still combat-ready / moved
bda.text6: updating the situational picture and immediate correction of further steps

prediction.title: Prediction of the opponent's reaction
prediction.text2: AI-DEF also works with what will follow the hit:
prediction.text3: Typical reaction prediction: move, disperse, camouflage, counterattack, change EW mode
prediction.text4: estimation of other likely contacts and directions of leakage
prediction.text5: Recommendations for continuation: repeated intervention, corridor blocking, change of sensor mode, transfer of own assets
prediction.text6: Added value: You don't stop after hitting — you continue ahead because you know what your opponent is likely to do.

result.title: The result
result.text2: Shorter kill chain, higher accuracy, fewer errors, lower collateral damage and higher resistance to interference, shorter cycle time, higher durability.
result.text3: kratší OODA / kill chain: FIND → FIX → TRACK → ASSETS → ATTACK → BDA → predikcia reakcie
result.text4: Fewer errors and delays in decision-making
result.text5: higher resilience in EW and the dynamics of modern conflict
result.text6: Scaling capabilities without increasing the number of analysts
